name: Mirrorwell Media
full_legal_name: Mirrorwell Media & Cognitive Broadcast Corponation, Ltd.-S
employees: 29,000 direct; 1.2 million content licensees and signal hosts
sovereign_territory: The Mirrorwell Arcology — a 62-story broadcast and residential tower in the former Chicago Loop, legally designated sovereign territory from the 4th floor upward; floors 1–3 remain Chicago municipal jurisdiction by treaty, creating a unique contested threshold zone locals call 'the Lobby War'
founding_story: Mirrorwell was founded in 2149 by Celestine Achebe-Rourke, a former neural-interface UX designer who became convinced that traditional media — even immersive VR — was failing because it asked audiences to consume content rather than believe they had created it. Her foundational product, the ECHO ENGINE, was a broadcast algorithm that personalized media feeds so precisely that viewers reported feeling the content had been made specifically for them. The algorithm's secondary effect — that viewers became emotionally unable to consume media from competing platforms — was not disclosed in the original prospectus. Achebe-Rourke called it 'resonance loyalty.' Regulators called it psychological dependency architecture. She incorporated before they could act.
security_force: The Signal Corps — a lean 1,800-person security division that operates more like an intelligence agency than a conventional force. Signal Corps agents specialize in information warfare, blackmail architecture, and what Mirrorwell internally terms 'broadcast deterrence' — the credible threat of weaponizing a target's personal data, purchasing history, and neural-interface usage logs as public narrative. They have never fired a conventional weapon in a documented engagement.
key_detail: Mirrorwell's ECHO ENGINE has evolved significantly since 2149. Current internal versions — designated ECHO ENGINE 7.2 — are believed to incorporate predictive emotional modeling that can determine a viewer's psychological vulnerabilities within 11 minutes of engagement and begin targeted cognitive softening within 40 minutes. The corponation insists this is 'personalized engagement optimization.' Three former senior engineers have disappeared after attempting to whistleblow. One reappeared as a Mirrorwell brand ambassador.
relationship_to_big_20: Member of the Big 20. Holds the media seat and is formally at peace with Vantablack Media, though their relationship is the most hostile non-kinetic rivalry in the Big 20 — a continuous shadow war of audience capture, talent poaching, and algorithmic sabotage. Mirrorwell targets the neural-interface-equipped upper-corridor demographic; Vantablack dominates the physical broadcast and street-level market. Both claim the middle tier is theirs.
full_text: Mirrorwell Media & Cognitive Broadcast Corponation (MWL-S) is GLMZ's preeminent immersive media and cognitive advertising empire, operating from its sovereign arcology in the former Chicago Loop. Founded by the visionary and widely feared Celestine Achebe-Rourke in 2149, Mirrorwell built its Φ980 billion valuation on the ECHO ENGINE — a broadcast algorithm that does not merely deliver content but restructures the viewer's relationship to reality through hyper-personalized resonance modeling. With 29,000 direct employees and 1.2 million content licensees functioning as a distributed signal network, Mirrorwell's reach extends into virtually every neural-interface-equipped household in the corridor. Its Signal Corps security force wages information warfare rather than conventional combat, making it simultaneously one of the least visibly violent and most feared sovereign entities in GLMZ. The 'Lobby War' — the contested threshold between Chicago municipal jurisdiction and Mirrorwell sovereignty on the arcology's lower floors — has become a symbol of the corponation's philosophy: even the boundary of its power is a performance.

glmzTerritory.description: The Mirrorwell Arcology — 62-story broadcast and residential tower in Chicago's River North district, Zone 1. Produces the GLMZ's second-most-watched content slate after Waxwing Neuromedia. Mirrorwell's Zone 1 position is contested — Waxwing has attempted acquisition four times.
glmzTerritory.grayZoneRelationship: Mirrorwell crews enter Gray Zones for content production. Their footage constitutes the primary visual record of Gray Zone life that Tier 4-5 citizens ever see.
